mission.title: Trigger
mission.description: Get Commander Lock's message from Colt.

npc.say:
What?! He terminated Sentinels with a gesture?!
Blast them to hell! They WERE lying!

Mauser and I were crewmates under Roland. Mauser was a good man--a good friend. I figured he'd gone down with the Hammer when the Machines wiped Zion's mainframe. Then there were rumors that Mervs had spotted him in Zion during the Sentinel attack... And now it turns out that he *was* alive, saving Lock's commissioned butt, and getting killed for it.
Just... Damn it.
You'd better get going, operative. Those programs aren't just waiting around.

phase.briefing:
Hello, {player}! Colt has been in contact with E Pluribus Neo again, and they say they have a message from Commander Lock for us! He's recuperating in the old city, where EPN has established a base; hopefully it won't be long before he's well enough to be brought here, to New Zion.
Please report to Colt, and get the Commander's message. It will be wonderful to hear from him, won't it?

enter.say:
Sounds like *someone* got up on the right side of the bed this morning...
Colt should be in there. Looks like the message from Lock is already incoming on one of the terminals.

done.say: Aw, hell. Don't look now, but you've got a level 100 stalker.

talk.say:
How touching.
Now, what was that about a "lightning gun"? You people have the capability of fighting Sentinels yourselves? Huh.

done.say:
Bet your wiry ass we do! Mauser'd be a match for any Sentinel. They must've got him with numbers. Damn it...
Yeah, buddy. Hell, Neo was one of us, and he didn't even need a gun. He could just wave his hands, man, and the squids fried.

What?! He terminated Sentinels with a gesture?!
Blast them to hell! They WERE lying!

complete.say: Damn it, Mauser. Why'd you have to go get yourself killed for Lock? Just a goddamn waste...

phase.briefing: Warrior, reports of hostile "accelerated" programs just started coming in from all over the city. I need you to rendezvous with Ghost immediately.

enter.say: Uh... You don't think this has something to do with that little shouting fit he had back there, do you?
Was it something I said? Jesus...

talk.say:
The intruder's launched a major rampage, {player}. He's overriding programs indiscriminately; they're going to hurt a lot of people unless they get shut down in short order.
Take Acamar and Wasserman with you, and take out those programs.

done.say: You heard the man. Get those two and hit the road.

talk.say: What the hell have we stepped in now?

objective.text: Lead Acamar and Wasserman out of the area

phase.briefing: I'm sending you to the largest trouble indication we had, {player}. If you encounter the intruder himself, possibly you can find some way to...calm him down.

enter.say:
Well hey... At least when the city's a smoking ruin, we can look back and say we were there when he went over the edge.
Actually... Maybe we shouldn't tell anyone about that.
Okay, I've got a heap of accelerated signals in there, including something pretty big. Could be Chuckles.

objective.text: Kill all of the accelerated programs

done.say:
All right, get out of there, fast as you can.
Oh, sorry.

phase.briefing: Operative, Captain Niobe wanted to see you, but now I can't raise her. I'm sending you to her last broadcast point.

enter.say: I think I see Niobe in there, but I'm reading some accelerated programs as well.

objective.text: Kill all of the accelerated programs

done.say: All righty then, looks like someone already had things in hand.

talk.say:
{player}! I'm glad to see you.
Look, I don't know what set him off, but we're going to have to find the intruder and chill him out. This tantrum of his is going to cause major problems if it lasts much longer.

done.say: He said someone lied to him? Do you have any idea what he was talking about?

mission.finish:
The intruder's dropped off our scanners, operative. We're going to have to try to track him down before he starts another outbreak of overridden programs.
And {player}, thank you for relaying the message from Commander Lock. I'm going to send it to the Council right away. The news about Mauser is terrible, but Zion will never forget what he did for the Commander.
